benefits.title: Why teams switch to Taskline
benefits.subtitle: Four things change the week you move your plan into one place.

items.title: See the whole project at a glance
items.text: Boards, lists and timelines show status in one view, so nothing hides in a spreadsheet.

items.title: Timelines that adjust with you
items.text: Shift one date and dependent tasks move with it, so plans stay honest when work slips.

items.title: Fewer check in meetings
items.text: Comments, mentions and approvals live on the task, so context never gets lost in chat.

items.title: Know where time goes
items.text: Workload and progress views show who is overloaded before a deadline slips.

how.title: From messy plan to clear week in three steps

items.q: How long is the free trial?
items.a: The trial lasts 14 days and includes all Growth features. You do not need a credit card to start it.

items.q: Can I cancel at any time?
items.a: Yes. Cancel from your account settings in two clicks. Your data stays available until the end of the paid period.

items.q: Can I import work from another tool?
items.a: Yes. Import tasks from a spreadsheet or from common project tools. A guided import walks you through the columns.

items.q: Can guests see only their project?
items.a: Yes. Guests see only the projects you invite them to, and nothing else in your workspace.
